title: Loi sur les impots (Taxation Act)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre I-3 LOI SUR LES IMPOTS'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Quebec is the only province that administers and collects its own personal income tax rather than relying on a federal collection agreement, so source withholding for Quebec employees is governed here and by the Loi sur l'administration fiscale, RLRQ c. A-6.002, and administered by Revenu Quebec - unlike Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba, where withholding runs through the federal Income Tax Act.
